soc.rest_travel.rationale: Draft maps only domestic football-data (R) for fixtures; European/cup fixtures named in the label are not in results_shots_cards (five/ten domestic leagues only) and need fixtures_intl; PLAYER_BOX match is spurious (no player data needed for rest/km).

soc.lineups_pit.rationale: Confirmed timestamped lineups need only soc.lineups_pregame (LIVE_SNAPSHOT, prospective capture); PLAYER_BOX=player_stats_lineups and TEAM_BOX are spurious and make it BLOCKED_NO_FREE_SOURCE instead of COLLECT_PROSPECTIVE. History is unavailable (final-only lineups).

soc.injuries.rationale: Injuries/suspensions need soc.injuries_suspensions (current lists only, LIVE_SNAPSHOT), not lineups_pregame; PLAYER_BOX/TEAM_BOX are spurious. Historical vintages do not exist, so prospective capture only.

soc.motivation.rationale: Derived from the Monte Carlo season simulation leverage (soc.stakes_leverage / soc.comp_sim) and the rotation index; draft's only need is EVENT=xg_events (spurious). Needs fixtures/results, competition rules and pre-match lineups (rotation) which are prospective-only.

soc.weather.rationale: raw_data is hourly forecast + archive weather and a stadium table; SCHEME and EVENT (xg_events, SAMPLE_ONLY) are spurious matches ('pitch', 'set-piece'?) and make it BLOCKED_SAMPLE_ONLY. Real needs are weather_forecast_pit (history only ~2022, host blocked from runner), weather_observed, venue_geo.

soc.comp_sim.rationale: Season Monte Carlo from the goal model with tiebreak rules; NEWS=transfers_values is spurious and drags it to COLLECT_PROSPECTIVE/ToS flag. It is a derived simulation: upstream goal model and tiebreaker rules; raw reads are results/fixtures and rules.

soc.transfers.rationale: raw_data needs market values by date, dated registered transfers and head-coach appointments (transfers_values; as-of-date values only via archives) and expected minutes; EVENT=xg_events is spurious and CONTRACTS (market values) is missing. Rating shift is fitted on the goal-rate rating.

soc.player_awards.rationale: Derived: Poisson race simulation using shrunk npxG/90 x expected minutes + penalty xG with tie-breaks; upstream inputs must cap its status.

soc.fouls_cards.rationale: Draft COMPUTED_FULL is optimistic: referee name exists only for EPL (~20% mean over league files) and player-level cards need player_stats_lineups (NO_FREE_SOURCE); football-data has team fouls/cards only. EVENT and AWARDS matches are spurious.

soc.formation.rationale: Pregame formation/expected pressing matchup needs the confirmed XI/formation (lineups_pregame, live-snapshot only) in addition to shot/press events (StatsBomb sample); LINEUP need is missing so PIT_SAFE is wrong.

soc.xg_adjusted_ratings.rationale: Derived from soc.xg (opponent/venue adjusted xG) and needs shot-level xG; VENUE geo is spurious (home term only). Must be capped by soc.xg.

soc.finishing_regression.rationale: Derived from soc.xg vs goals; RULES=competition_rules is spurious. Needs shot-level xG (SAMPLE_ONLY) so status must be capped by soc.xg.

soc.keeper_shot_stopping_regression.rationale: Draft COMPUTED_PROXY is optimistic: per-keeper PSxG vs saves needs shot-level post-shot xG (xg_events sample only) and keeper identity (player_stats_lineups NO_FREE_SOURCE); derived from soc.gk.

soc.xi_strength_delta.rationale: Confirmed XI vs season-average XI requires the confirmed lineup (lineups_pregame, live-snapshot only) and player values/xG; LINEUP need missing and PIT_SAFE is wrong since historical confirmed XIs cannot be rebuilt.

soc.rotation_index.rationale: Predicted rotation needs historical starting XIs (player_stats_lineups) and congestion/fixtures; EVENT=xg_events is spurious. Pregame lineup vintages are unavailable historically.

soc.press_conference_news.rationale: Timestamped statements need a news archive (xx.news_timestamped, prospective), not transfers_values; AVAIL (doubtful/out flags) via injuries_suspensions is missing.

soc.stakes_leverage.rationale: Leverage is computed from the season Monte Carlo (E[value(win)]-E[value(loss)]): derived from soc.comp_sim; EVENT=xg_events is spurious.

soc.second_leg_aggregate_state.rationale: Needs leg results of cup/European ties and the rule table (fixtures_intl + competition_rules); PLAYER_BOX/EVENT/TEAM_BOX (domestic football-data) are spurious/wrong dataset, so BLOCKED_NO_FREE_SOURCE is too pessimistic. ET/leg flags are uncertain in fixtures_intl.

soc.group_stage_scenarios.rationale: Group outcomes are enumerated by simulation with the tiebreak order: derived from the rating/goal model and tiebreaker rules; results for the group-stage competitions are in fixtures_intl, not domestic football-data.

soc.rivalry_intensity.rationale: AWARDS match is spurious ('derby' is a local rivalry, not a contest); needs a curated derby list plus geographic distance and results.

soc.open_game_index.rationale: Derived from the goal model (Dixon-Coles lambdas and correlation) plus lineup/keeper adjustment; upstream inputs should cap status.

soc.remaining_schedule_strength.rationale: Derived: expected points of remaining fixtures from team ratings, home advantage and rest, embedded in the simulation; remaining fixture list is a fixtures dataset need (fixtures_intl).

soc.points_deductions.rationale: Open cases/announced deductions are dated news items (xx.news_timestamped), not transfers_values; CONTRACTS match is spurious ('contract wording' refers to the Kalshi contract).

soc.cup_progression_load.rationale: Joint multi-competition simulation with a rotation model: derived; fixtures of all competitions (fixtures_intl) and historical lineup strength by competition (player_stats_lineups) are needed.

soc.squad_depth_value.rationale: Needs squad market values/ratings (transfers_values, as-of vintages not preserved) and injury-absence distributions (injuries_suspensions), not lineups_pregame; PIT_UNAVAILABLE_HISTORICALLY stands.

soc.preseason_prior.rationale: Draft COLLECT_FREE_MEASURED/PIT_SAFE is optimistic: the measurement regresses on log squad market value, net transfers and promoted flag; transfers_values only gives current values (as-of past dates only via archives), so history is not point-in-time.

soc.leader_race_state.rationale: Derived race simulation (npxG/90, expected minutes, penalty xG, tie-break rules, injury hazard) from upstream inputs; AVAIL should be injuries_suspensions.

soc.award_voting_narrative.rationale: Media-share proxies need timestamped news (xx.news_timestamped), not transfers_values; also updated with trophy simulations (derived from soc.comp_sim).

soc.paired_team_correlation.rationale: Derived from the posterior-sampled season simulation; must be capped by soc.comp_sim and rating uncertainty.

soc.points_total_distribution.rationale: WEATHER_FCST matched only the word 'forecast' in 'preseason forecasts' (own model forecasts) and NEWS=transfers_values is spurious; these produce a false PIT_UNAVAILABLE verdict. It is a Monte Carlo derived input using final points history.

soc.ratings_uncertainty.rationale: Posterior rating uncertainty/drift is derived from the rating model (soc.ratings).

soc.score_effects_adjusted_xg.rationale: Derived from soc.xg and score-state splits (soc.score_state); PLAYER_BOX is spurious.

soc.keeper_workload.rationale: Derived: expected SOT from team shot generation times PSxG-based save probability; upstream soc.shots and soc.gk.

soc.team_fail_to_score_propensity.rationale: Needs the team's historical starting XIs (player_stats_lineups, no free full-coverage feed), not the prospective lineups_pregame feed; Understat shot xG is sample-only. Draft COLLECT_PROSPECTIVE hides a harder block.

soc.points_gap_state.rationale: raw_data includes a points-deduction log and a fixture list with played flag; football-data has played matches only. Deductions come from soc.points_deductions and fixtures from fixtures_intl.

soc.h2h_zero_sum_fixtures.rationale: Remaining direct fixtures with date and venue need a fixtures list (fixtures_intl), and win probabilities come from the goal model; VENUE geo is spurious.

soc.shared_shock_overlap.rationale: raw_data needs fixtures by competition and international call-up lists (announcement news), absent from the draft; AVAIL=lineups_pregame is wrong. Derived from congestion/international-break inputs.

soc.bracket_path_difficulty.rationale: Derived from bracket draw, tie format and opponent ratings via simulation; needs cup/international fixtures, not only domestic football-data.

soc.playoff_format_conversion.rationale: Needs a historical seed-outcome table of playoff ties (results, fixtures_intl) as well as format rules; draft has RULES only.

soc.top_two_order_statistics.rationale: Derived from the posterior-sampled season simulation; NEWS=transfers_values is spurious and creates a false PIT_UNAVAILABLE verdict. Historical leader margins come from final tables (results).

soc.uefa_league_phase_simulation.rationale: Simulation of UEFA league phase: needs league-phase fixtures/played results of European competitions (fixtures_intl), which football-data domestic leagues lack; derived from rating model and tiebreakers.

soc.seeded_bracket_path_given_finish.rationale: Derived: bracket path conditional on league-phase finishing rank, read from the league-phase simulation and draw/bracket rules.

soc.club_multi_competition_dependence.rationale: Derived joint simulation; raw_data needs trophy results, squad injury days (injuries_suspensions, current only) and fixture calendar; draft AVAIL=lineups_pregame is the wrong dataset and fixtures/awards needs are missing.

soc.half_specific_xg_ratings.rationale: Derived from soc.xg split by half using shot-level minute data (sample only).

soc.second_half_state_multiplier.rationale: raw_data is half-time score, second-half goals and red cards: football-data columns (HTHG/HTAG, red-card counts) cover this; EVENT=xg_events (SAMPLE_ONLY) is the wrong dataset. Red-card minute is not available, so only a coarse version.

soc.half_level_dependence_rho.rationale: raw_data is half-time and full-time scores per match, available in football-data (HTHG/HTAG, 2015-2026) as the period_split input already uses; EVENT=xg_events (SAMPLE_ONLY) is the wrong dataset.

soc.knockout_cagey_factor.rationale: raw_data is cup match results with stage, leg, ET/penalty flags plus pre-match ratings; football-data is domestic league only, so the draft's TEAM_BOX=R cannot supply cup stage/leg data (fixtures_intl, results only) and the rule definitions are needed.

soc.method_path_tree_calibration.rationale: raw_data is knockout results with ET/pens fields and pre-match rating gap: a results-level need (fixtures_intl) plus rules; EVENT=xg_events (sample) is the wrong dataset.

soc.winning_margin_distribution.rationale: Derived from the joint goal model: depends on the rating and Dixon-Coles inputs.

soc.cross_tier_strength_link.rationale: raw_data is inter-division match results (cups, European, friendlies) plus club Elo history; football-data is domestic-league-only so TEAM_BOX=R cannot supply cross-division matches (fixtures_intl); VENUE geo is spurious. Elo host blocked from runner.

soc.blowout_tail_inflation.rationale: Needs the pre-match model expected goal difference per match: derived from the rating/goal model.

soc.league_strength_dispersion.rationale: Input is team ratings per league-season: derived from soc.ratings.

soc.latent_form_persistence.rationale: Needs pre-match ratings with timestamps (residuals of soc.ratings); derived.

soc.total_goal_tail_dispersion.rationale: Needs pre-match expected totals from the goal model: derived.

soc.shared_openness_latent_factor.rationale: raw_data requires team PPDA and style metrics (event data: xg_events sample or Opta), missing from the draft; PLAYER_BOX is spurious.

soc.xi_attack_defence_split.rationale: raw_data needs player xG/xGA on-off (shot-level xG; xg_events sample) in addition to lineups and minutes; EVENT need missing.

soc.cross_and_wide_play_share.rationale: Crosses and final-third entries by zone are event/tracking data (Opta; StatsBomb sample), not player_stats_lineups.

soc.corner_taken_definition_flag.rationale: AWARDS match is spurious (corners 'awarded'); needs rules text and provider definitions only.

soc.dnp_and_sub_entry_settlement.rationale: raw_data needs substitutions with minute and player minutes (event/box data), not only the prospective lineup feed; missing EVENT/PLAYER_BOX needs.

soc.keeper_saves_from_sot_and_psxg.rationale: Derived from team shots/SOT (soc.shots) and PSxG; team-level SOT/goals conceded are in football-data, PSxG only in xg_events sample.

soc.shot_event_definition_mapping.rationale: Needs shot counts from two providers for the same matches: football-data (R) and an event provider (xg_events sample); PLAYER_BOX is spurious.

soc.pair_player_tournament_tally_joint.rationale: Derived from the player tournament scoring pool and tournament simulation; international goals/minutes plus penalty duty.

soc.influencer_pk_duel_skill.rationale: Exhibition contestants' prior duel outcomes come from video/social posts, not StatsBomb events; EVENT/AWARDS matches are spurious. Needs format rules and dated news/video logs.

soc.tournament_joint_finish_distribution.rationale: Full group-and-bracket simulation: needs international results/fixtures (fixtures_intl), tiebreak tables, derived from rating posteriors; domestic football-data cannot supply national-team results.

soc.match_format_rules_profile.rationale: Needs rulebook fields (xx.rules_reference) and match results (fixtures_intl); PLAYER_BOX is spurious.

soc.wc_award_selection_profile.rationale: Historical Ball winners (awards) are the core raw data; AWARDS need missing from the draft.

soc.player_tournament_match_exposure.rationale: Derived from the tournament simulation (team progression) plus player appearances.

soc.country_first_tournament_goal_race.rationale: Derived from team lambdas, player goal shares and penalty-taker status.

soc.tournament_goal_environment.rationale: Needs World Cup/international match-level goals by stage (fixtures_intl); football-data (club leagues) is the wrong dataset. Pre-tournament ratings derived.

soc.tournament_common_shock_factor.rationale: Needs international match goals by tournament (fixtures_intl) and directive/law-change dates (rules documents); PLAYER_BOX spurious, TEAM_BOX=R is club only.

soc.group_gap_composition.rationale: Group draw and national-team ratings: needs international fixtures/results (fixtures_intl) and derives from soc.ratings.

soc.team_tournament_goal_expectation.rationale: raw_data is international results with goals/venue and the 2026 draw/fixtures; football-data club leagues cannot supply that (fixtures_intl). Derived from rating and bracket simulation.

soc.ko_round_outcome_counts.rationale: LINEUP=lineups_pregame is spurious (drove COLLECT_PROSPECTIVE); needs knockout results with decided_by (fixtures_intl) and a bracket simulation.

soc.group_table_pattern_probability.rationale: Group fixtures and historical group tables are international (fixtures_intl); derived from the group rank simulation.

soc.champion_path_trailing_probability.rationale: Needs goal minutes for past champions' matches (event data) and simulated paths; EVENT need is missing and PLAYER_BOX is spurious.

soc.tournament_player_scoring_pool.rationale: Derived from simulated team goals per match and player xG/penalty status.

soc.neutral_final_venue_split.rationale: Needs ticket allocation per side (announcements) and venue/fixture history; EVENT, PLAYER_BOX and TEAM_BOX are spurious, so BLOCKED_NO_FREE_SOURCE is too pessimistic.

soc.prepack_leg_definition_parse.rationale: raw_data is Kalshi rules_primary/rules_secondary text with version timestamps (mkt.kalshi_rules); PLAYER_BOX/TEAM_BOX are spurious.

soc.return_to_play_timeline.rationale: Injury spells and medical bulletins come from injuries_suspensions plus timestamped news, not lineups_pregame; NEWS need missing.

soc.pair_onpitch_overlap_model.rationale: raw_data includes coach tenure dates (manager appointments; transfers_values/news), missing from the draft.

soc.window_qualifying_fixture_count.rationale: CONTRACTS=transfers_values is spurious ('contract window' is the Kalshi contract); needs fixture dates/competition/official flag (fixtures_intl) and survival probabilities.

soc.squad_list_deadline_and_replacement_.rationale: CONTRACTS=transfers_values is spurious ('contract text per series' is the Kalshi contract); needs regulation articles and Kalshi rules.

soc.squad_announcement_leak_reports.rationale: Timestamped report logs need xx.news_timestamped, not transfers_values.

soc.player_tournament_participation_inte.rationale: Dated statements and retirement records are news (xx.news_timestamped, prospective); draft's PLAYER_BOX/TEAM_BOX are spurious and NEWS is missing.

soc.current_win_run_state.rationale: AVAIL=lineups_pregame and EVENT=xg_events are spurious; raw_data is match date, competition and result incl. ET/penalty outcome, a results need that is not pregame-vintage sensitive.

soc.calendar_year_fixture_sequence.rationale: Fixture list with dates and cup draw results need a fixtures dataset (fixtures_intl); venue geo alone cannot supply it.

soc.season_boundary_strength_reset.rationale: Derived from club Elo/ratings, transfers and manager changes; upstream soc.ratings, soc.transfers, soc.preseason_prior should cap it.

soc.promotion_relegation_playoff_bracket.rationale: Needs historical playoff ties with leg scores/ET/shootouts (results-level) and format rules; EVENT=xg_events (sample) is the wrong dataset.

soc.pre_ceremony_leak_signal.rationale: Timestamped leak reports need xx.news_timestamped, not transfers_values.

soc.season_minutes_survival_curve.rationale: Injury episodes with dates/durations come from injuries_suspensions (current lists only), not lineups_pregame; history of episodes cannot be rebuilt.

soc.last_place_extreme_value.rationale: Needs a simulated points matrix: derived from soc.comp_sim.

soc.contract_expiry_release_state.rationale: Contract end snapshots, release clauses and renewal reports come from contracts/news (transfers_values current values; xx.contracts_finance; xx.news_timestamped); PLAYER_BOX is spurious so BLOCKED_NO_FREE_SOURCE is too pessimistic.

soc.transfer_window_calendar_hazard.rationale: Needs transfer completion dates (transfers_values) and window calendars (rules); EVENT=xg_events is spurious.

soc.manager_dismissal_hazard.rationale: Needs dated manager appointments/exits (transfers_values manager changes) and results/expected points from the rating model; EVENT=xg_events is spurious.

soc.governance_procedure_stage.rationale: Draft COLLECT_FREE_MEASURED/PIT_SAFE is optimistic: the procedure timeline records (FFP, UEFA sanctions, FIFA bids) are dated news/documents, not in football-data; TEAM_BOX is spurious.

soc.destination_club_feasibility.rationale: raw_data needs club wage bills/accounts (xx.contracts_finance) and timestamped transfer reports (xx.news_timestamped); CONTRACTS need missing and NEWS mapped to transfers_values.

soc.fixture_sequence_win_vector.rationale: Derived: per-fixture win probabilities from goal model with venue, rest and lineup scenario, cup survival; needs the fixture list (fixtures_intl).

soc.official_announcement_signals.rationale: CONTRACTS spurious (Kalshi contract wording); announcement calendars need timestamped news, not transfers_values.

soc.host_venue_relocation_risk.rationale: Dated relocation news items are xx.news_timestamped, not transfers_values; scheduled matches per host region need fixtures.

soc.extra_time_phase_scoring_rate.rationale: raw_data needs goal events with minutes 91-120, substitutions and red-card minutes (event data; xg_events sample) and ET flags; EVENT need missing, PLAYER_BOX spurious.

soc.abandonment_risk.rationale: Postponed/abandoned fixtures are absent from football-data (played matches only); needs a dated postponement log (news) and weather forecast at decision time; draft uses observed weather only.

soc.group_rank_joint_distribution.rationale: Derived from group simulation with tiebreaks and team ratings; international match results (fixtures_intl) not domestic football-data.

soc.pair_meeting_probability.rationale: Derived from simulated slot occupancy and the bracket graph.

soc.tie_advancement_state_tree.rationale: raw_data is tie results with leg scores, ET and penalties (results-level, fixtures_intl) plus rule table; EVENT=xg_events is the wrong dataset. Composition layer reads soc.second_leg_aggregate_state.

m.strike_hit_rates.rationale: Realised YES rate minus de-vigged pre-close price: market-derived benchmark (Kalshi/sportsbook prices); catalog draft missed it and mapped only results.

m.settlement_truth.rationale: Needs the independently computed result to flag wording/void disagreements, i.e. results data in addition to Kalshi settlement.

m.rules_text.rationale: TEAM_BOX/RULES are spurious; the quantity is Kalshi rules text stored with a version hash at each fetch, so version history exists only from capture.

m.lifecycle.rationale: Status transitions with timestamps are Kalshi/market lifecycle logs plus postponement news; AVAIL=lineups_pregame and PLAYER_BOX are spurious.

m.fees.rationale: Fee schedule is a published contract-structure reference, not a market-derived price signal; EVENT/RULES/CONTRACTS matches are spurious.

registry_objections.objection: Title omits half-time goals (HTHG/HTAG) and red-card counts, which football-data.co.uk league CSVs carry and which period_split relied on; also referee column is EPL-only so referee history is not available for the other leagues (agree with measured miss).
history first/last unset and 'results only' - martj42 also carries goalscorer minutes and shootouts, but these are not registered; international/tournament inputs depend on this unmeasured coverage.
